root_cause.text: The `mt7925_tx_check_aggr` function in the mt76 wireless driver dereferences the `sta` pointer to access `sta->link` without first verifying that `sta` is non-NULL.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit `if (!sta) return;` check at the start of the function, preceding the `rcu_dereference(sta->link[wcid->link_id])` call which previously executed unconditionally before the combined NULL check.
